thread:
olivia: Quick follow-up from the authn/authz postmortem. We need concrete owners, timelines, and a plan for the recurring monthly auth spike. Goal: close remediation loop before next billing cycle.

ben: I'll take the token-validation work. Plan: add stricter JWT kid handling, tighten parsing, and add e2e tests. Will create ticket and include perf/accuracy acceptance.
sarah: I'll own audit coverage for secret deletions and token lifecycle events. Will add `audit.secret.deleted` and `audit.token.*` events with full fields.
kai: I'll own secrets rotation scheduling and the canary rollout automation. Also will add rollback playbook to confluence.

olivia: Please include realistic ETAs and any infra dependencies. Also product/compliance want SLA updates and evidence for the next review.

ben: INF-9201 created: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-9201. ETA 8d. Acceptance: validation error rate <0.05%, p99 latency <450ms, tests covering malformed tokens.
sarah: AUD-9202 opened for audit events and dashboard. ETA 6d. I'll add Kibana saved queries and grant read access to security/compliance.
kai: SECR-9203 for runbook + canary automation. ETA 12d. Confluence draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SECR/Rotation-Playbook (will PR).

compliance-bot: Compliance reminder: upcoming audit window 2026-07-10. Please surface runbook and audit evidence by 2026-07-03.

olivia: Also this recurring pattern: auth spikes in day 2-4 of month. Proposal: detector metric `auth.anomalies.monthly_spike` + 30m alert and an incident runbook that auto-tags events so we can correlate with deployments.

ben: I'll add a synthetic monthly-spike regression test and an alert. TEST-9210 ETA 5d.
sarah: For audit logs, will ensure both successful and failed refresh token attempts are recorded with `actor`, `resource`, `reason`. Will add sampling to avoid noise.
kai: Canary plan: double-write new key for 6h, monitor auth error delta and latency. If delta > 0.2% or new errors spike, auto-rollback.

infra-bot: Noted: migration may touch token serializer in commit ab12f4. Staging canary scheduled 2026-06-15.

ben: Quick repro snippet I'll add to INF-9201:
```
ERROR auth: token validation rejected: missing kid
payload: {"alg":"none","sub":"svc-account:mailer"}
```

sarah: Dashboard will include counts for `audit.token.create`, `audit.token.refresh`, `audit.token.delete` and a heatmap for monthly spike windows. I'll post link to AUD-9202.

olivia: Action summary (owner + ticket + ETA):
- INF-9201 (ben)  token validation hardening + tests  8d
- AUD-9202 (sarah)  audit events + dashboard + access control  6d
- SECR-9203 (kai)  rotation runbook + canary automation  12d
- TEST-9210 (ben/infra)  monthly-spike regression test + alerting  5d
Please ack and call out any blockers (infra, compliance, product).

ben: Ack. Blocking: need a short-lived creds perm for the test harness (will request via INF-ops).
sarah: Ack. Blocking: need log index retention verification from infra.
kai: Ack. Blocking: need KMS canary quota and staging windows (pinging infra).

olivia: I'll add these to the postmortem doc and schedule a 15m standup Fri 09:30 for status until tickets close. Blameless follow-up only.

infra-bot: Staging canary window reserved 2026-06-15 to 2026-06-18. KMS quota increased for canary by request.

compliance-bot: Reminder: preserve audit evidence artifacts in /shared/compliance/authn-evidence.

olivia: Thanks all. I'll update the postmortem with owners/ETAs and push a summary to leadership.
